امتزجن (form VIII)
# اِمْتَزَجْنَ (imtazajna) /im.ta.zad͡ʒ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِمْتَزَجَ (imtazaja)
# اُمْتُزِجْنَ (umtuzijna) /um.tu.zid͡ʒ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِمْتَزَجَ (imtazaja)
# اِمْتَزِجْنَ (imtazijna) /im.ta.zid͡ʒ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِمْتَزَجَ (imtazaja)
